title: Gilneas: Exile and Return
summary: The worgen curse, Forsaken invasion, years of exile, and later reclamation form a long story of home and identity.
opening: Gilneas was lost amid a curse and invasion. Its people carried both wounds into exile before a later generation could speak of return.
reviewNote: Review the original Gilneas starting experience and released reclamation quests for leadership and exact outcome. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Establish the worgen crisis within isolated Gilneas. Follow the Forsaken attack and the night elves' aid. Trace the displaced Gilneans' long interim. Verify the return campaign and the kingdom's new state.

chapters.title: Behind the wall
chapters.body: Behind Gilneas’s isolation, the worgen curse brought danger within the kingdom’s own walls.

chapters.title: The kingdom falls
chapters.body: The Forsaken invasion deepened the crisis, while the night elves offered aid. Home could no longer be kept as its people had known it.

chapters.title: Life beyond Gilneas
chapters.body: Displaced Gilneans carried the curse and the memory of invasion through years of exile. Their kingdom endured as a longing beyond the lost walls.

chapters.title: Reclaiming Gilneas
chapters.body: A later return opened another chapter for Gilneas. The kingdom’s changed life and the cost of reclamation remain unfinished in this account.
